description: This file defines the interface MedicationDispenseDAO, which specifies database operations related to the MedicationDispense entity in the OpenMRS system. It includes methods for retrieving, saving, and deleting MedicationDispense objects, and outlines criteria-based querying.

classes.name: MedicationDispenseDAO
classes.description: Interface providing database access methods for MedicationDispense objects, including retrieval by id or UUID, criteria-based search, save, and delete operations.

methods.name: getMedicationDispenseByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a MedicationDispense object using its universally unique identifier (UUID).

methods.name: getMedicationDispenseByCriteria
methods.description: Returns a list of MedicationDispense objects matching specified criteria.

methods.name: saveMedicationDispense
methods.description: Persists a MedicationDispense object to the database.

methods.name: deleteMedicationDispense
methods.description: Removes a MedicationDispense object from the database.
